hooks.name: bucket_empty
hooks.neoforge: none (vanilla BucketItem.emptyContents; NeoForge has no matching event)

rust_summary: a server player emptying a bucket, cancellable (`native_bucket_empty`).
doc_summary: a server player emptying a bucket: `native_bucket_empty(player, name, pos, fluid, cancel)` is heard right before the fluid is placed, once the player may build there. A mod sets `cancel` and nothing is poured. The player's state is swapped in, so the helpers reach them. `native_fill_bucket` hears the same click without the player and the fluid; dispensers and cauldrons are not heard. Bundles that use it need `"hooks": @API:native_bucket_empty@`.
